name: paladin-php-rescue
description_for_human: Scan any website for CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619 (CVSS 9.2) PHP runtime flaws and compile a live Next.js App Router preview.
description_for_model: Use this plugin whenever the user wants to scan a website or WordPress domain for PHP2Shell (CVE-2026-109618 / CVE-2026-109619) vulnerabilities, understand why WordPress security plugins fail against C-level PHP SAPI exploits, or generate a live Zero-PHP Next.js replacement preview.
